walkthroughs.body_html:
Practical Performance — a core area of GCSE PE.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Practical Performance brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Practical Performance.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: How many bones are in the adult human skeleton?

options: Elbow
Knee
Hip
Wrist

mcqs.q: What causes muscle soreness 1-2 days after intense exercise?
options: Weightlifting.
Lactic acid still in the muscles.
Dehydration.
Microscopic muscle damage (DOMS), not lactic acid.

mcqs.q: What sport is best suited to type I (slow-twitch) fibres?
options: Endurance events like marathon running.
100m sprinting.
Weightlifting.
Dehydration.
Training as hard as possible immediately.
Doing less over time.
Dehydration.
Gradually increasing training demands so the body keeps adapting.
